basic_info.description: Classic 12-Unit Building in Prestigious Presidio Heights!    Rare opportunity to own a timeless 12-unit building with generous square footage in the highly sought-after Presidio Heights neighborhood! This well-maintained property features 12 oversized studios/junior 1-bedroom apartments, each with spacious closets. With 1 unit currently vacant, there is immediate rental potential.    Some units have been tastefully updated with modern kitchens and baths, and there's flexibility to convert the studios into true 1-bedroom apartments. Two units open to a charming deck and yard, providing a delightful outdoor space. The building also includes 5 car parking and convenient coin-operated laundry. Double-paned windows in the front and back enhance energy efficiency and noise reduction.    Located in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods, this property offers incredible upside potential, whether you're looking to maximize rental income or explore value-add opportunities.    Don't miss out on this exceptional investment - contact us today for a private showing!
